Are you an experienced reach truck driver looking for a role in a modern warehouse where every day brings new challenges? Then we have an exciting opportunity for you!

You will work in a dynamic environment where teamwork, safety, and quality are key. Together with your colleagues, you will help ensure that products are processed efficiently and delivered to customers around the world on time.

Cleaning individual components and complete products
Testing parts and fully assembled devices

If you start working as a production employee! Do you want to work with a salary of €33,85 per hour (shift allowance included)? Great! It's possible at Europastry in Steenbergen!

Wonderful to work with, isn't it?!  #baanrader

Job application
Convinced? Nice! Then apply quickly as a production employee! Good to know:

A job where you can work part time? Perfect! It’s possible in the warehouse of the best furniture store: Kwantum. You’ll get a salary of €15,60 per hour and the best colleagues. - Extra shift allowances
